title: Quality and Reusability Quadrant Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Place eight resource profiles in one of four quadrants, then see each profile plotted by its quality subtotal and reusability subtotal.

learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate resources that need quality work from resources that need reusability work by placing each of eight profiles in the correct one of four quadrants, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The ideas of the quality dimension, the reusability dimension, and quality versus reusability

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
commonMisconceptions: A high total means the resource is good in both ways
assessmentOpportunities: A polished e-book, all rights reserved, PDF only. Which quadrant?
A CC BY worksheet set with outdated links and no alt text. Which quadrant?
Which quadrant needs work on both subtotals?
Why report both subtotals and not only the total?

controls.name: Four quadrant buttons
controls.description: place the profile. The placement is final.

controls.name: Chart
controls.description: each answered profile appears as a numbered point, green when right the first time and red when missed. On a wide page the results screen shows all eight points.

controls.name: Play again** and the missed-profile review on the results screen.
